description: ZHANG Yifan Charles — exploring society and LLM-based social simulation.
introduction: So nice to meet you here!
about: I'm currently an undergraduate at the School of International Liberal Studies, Waseda University, and the School of International Studies, Peking University.
My aim is to explore the mechanisms that shape our society.
I believe real, interesting problems and ideas matter. Problems should never be confined by disciplinary boundaries.
interests: LLM-based social simulation, including political psychology, public space, and social capital.
